horses.spotlight_comment: Being related to a few winners for his stable, CAPE FEAR may be the answer with another step forward plausible. Al Maslool (second pick) has possibilities upped in trip, while Three No Trumps holds a good chance at the weights based on his 2yo effort. The market signals should be heeded with regard to the newcomers.[Steve Boow] Page 1 spotlightbeverley 23.04.26

Arrbob is better than he was able to show at Doncaster and Lauralynn belied her big price with a promising C&D run last week but the winner could come from the newcomers. MATTEO's yard won the race last year and has already sent out a useful winning newcomer so has a good deal going for him on the face of it. Beautiful Rainbow is much respected on pedigree while Half A Hoof represents a trainer with a 3-6 strike-rate with juveniles here. As ever, the betting will help to sort them out.[Emily Weber] Page 2 spotlightbeverley 23.04.26

Pleasingly competitive with several who can be fancied. I'm Next returned from a break with a bold bid here last week and he looks sure to go well again. Fuji Mountain, who only just lost out at Pontefract on Tuesday, Trilby, impressive when winning his sole C&D start, and Ventura Express, another with good course form, also have good claims but TEES AGGREGATES gets a narrow vote. The drying ground will be ideal and his AW return was encouraging.[Emily Weber] Page 3 spotlightbeverley 23.04.26

The signs look particularly good for FROSTMAGIC (nap), especially if he's again able to dominate. A War Eagle, who looks interesting back over this C&D, is second pick ahead of Nyman who may still have more to offer for his current yard. Milteye has a good chance provided he can overcome a wide draw.[Steve Boow] Page 4 spotlightbeverley 23.04.26

Kempton runner-up IWANTMYTIMEWITHYOU is taken to go one better, with progress possible back on turf. Attractively handicapped Kitsune Power is second choice, ahead of solid Freddy Robinson.[Steve Boow] Page 5 spotlightbeverley 23.04.26

first turf success for No Knee Never (second pick) looks very plausible but TEES GEORGE is a solid alternative. Maple has possibilities in his search for a first Flat win, while Copper And Five is interesting returned to this C&D.[Steve Boow] Page 6 spotlightbeverley 23.04.26

Off an attractive mark returned to this C&D and dropped to 0-60 level, COOLREE looks particularly interesting. Solid-looking Hashtagnotions is second choice, ahead of Hostelry who may stage a revival back in this scenario. Market confidence behind Glitter Code should be heeded.[Steve Boow] Page 7 spotlightbeverley 23.04.26

The shortlist is headed by the particularly interesting contenders VON DUTCH (narrowly preferred) and Alice De Clare who, among other things, may both improve for this switch to turf. Several others, notably Barbury Boy, also bring the possibility of faring better than previously. Smoker Bellamy looks the most solid contender in terms of form, having performed well on his reappearance.[Steve Boow] Page 8
